newsitem.title: USA: Webster Financial to buy Sachem Trust.
newsitem.headline: Webster Financial to buy Sachem Trust.

text.p: Webster Financial Corp said Tuesday it had agreed to buy Sachem Trust National Association in a stock swap valued at $18.30 for each Sachem Trust share.
The company said in a statement that the merger has an aggregate transaction value of $3.2 million. It is expected to close in the second quarter of 1997.
Under terms of the agreement, Sachem Trust shareholders will receive 0.493 of Webster common stock for each share of Sachem Trust common stock. The share exchange is tax free.
Webster will issue up to 85,333 shares of Webster common stock in exchange for all 173,000 outstanding shares of Sachem Trust. Sachem Trust is based in Guilford, Conn.
